latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of ctf-web skill.  
- Provides web exploitation techniques for CTF challenges: XSS, SQLi, SSTI, SSRF, CSRF, XXE, file upload bypasses, JWT attacks, prototype pollution, path traversal, command injection, auth bypass, SAML/OAuth exploitation, subdomain takeover, more.
- Includes quick reference plus detailed supporting files for a wide range of web attack techniques.
- Lists prerequisite tools and resources for common CTF platforms (Python, Linux, macOS, Go).
- Organizes content by attack type: server/client-side, authentication, Node.js, Web3, CVEs, and advanced techniques.
- For use with filesystem-enabled agents (e.g. Claude Code) with Bash and Python 3.
